## Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'

4. See error

What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behaviour

What actually happened. Include screenshots or screen recordings if helpful.

## Environment

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Squirrels version | e.g. 1.0.0 |
| WordPress version | e.g. 6.7 |
| WooCommerce version | e.g. 8.5 (or "not installed") |

| Browser | e.g. Chrome 124 |
| Active plugins | List all active plugins |
| Child theme active? | Yes / No |

## Error Messages

```
(paste errors here)
```

## Additional Context

**Before submitting:**
- [ ] I have searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate
